_comment: PER-REGION KISLEV+NORSCA tile of the TWW3 Old World mod parchment, placed by the paired-anchor-dot workflow (the same one validated on the Empire, 2026-08-14). The whole-map fit of this source is impossible — it draws different regions at inconsistent scale, so no single warp reconciles it (see the landmark-accuracy wall). Instead the user cropped Kislev+Norsca out (alpha-erasing everything outside it) and drew 13 matched colour dots on the crop AND on terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png, which IS the canvas/mask frame (8192x3616). The dot centroids, recovered by exact RGB, give 13 source<->canvas correspondences; a thin-plate through them places the tile exactly at every dot. objective=landmarks means NO silhouette fit (the drift-prone stage), just the interpolation. master_shape is the crop's native (h,w) = (1436,2939); the source is the dot-free, alpha-masked crop. This record only PLACES the tile (like the Empire tile); no geometry is extracted yet.
_comment_lattice: 6x6 over the crop (~490 master px horizontal spacing, ~239 vertical). The 13 dots span the region's coastal extremes (blue at the far-west tip, red far-east in Kislev, cyan at the north coast, yellow at the southern Kislev border); the lattice regularises the thin-plate and captures its affine trend out to the crop corners, where it extrapolates beyond the dot hull.
_comment_landmarks: source px = dot centroid in the crop's own 2939x1436 frame (x,y); canvas px = the SAME dot's centroid read straight off terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png (= canvas space, no globe-fit indirection). Paired by the colour the user drew. All 13 colours present in both frames (10 initial + orange/spring_green/azure added in the second pass). These ARE the fit (not a held-out check) for objective=landmarks.

record.notes: PROVISIONAL. Kislev+Norsca crop of the TWW3 Old World mod parchment ('The Old World, all faction starting positions v3.0'), registered against tools/derived/land_sea_mask.png by tools/fit_registration.py --seed tww3_old_world_mod_parchment_kislev_norsca (objective=landmarks; 10 user-drawn paired anchor dots read direct off terraqueous_globe_reprojected.png; 6x6 lattice). A DENSE Old World boundary network confined to Kislev+Norsca — the whole-source fit is defeated by its inconsistent inter-region scale, so this per-region carve is the way in. Contributes NO coastline (the mask remains the sole authority, user decision #1) and no geometry yet: this request only PLACES it. precedence/layer_precedence are PROVISIONAL placement values, to be revisited when boundary extraction lands (S6). MACHINE-FITTED; re-derive from the seed, do not hand-edit.
